summary: PAUSE migration verified end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest smoke tests pass (health, 12 categories, 437+ stories seeded, story detail with 6 chapters, IT/EN localization, user create/interests/bookmark/complete flow, stats, discover-next). Frontend Expo web preview loads correctly, onboarding (intro -> topics -> tabs) works, Discover deck shows story cards, tapping opens /deep-dive/[id] with 6-chapter pager + Listen button, bookmark toggles and appears in Saved tab, Profile shows persisted stats (1 completed, streak, minutes) and IT/EN language toggle, Topics tab shows all 12 categories with correct counts. Only issue: /api/category-media/{id} and /api/media/{story_id} return 500 because the source-repo hero/illustration paths point to Object Storage assets that don't exist in this Emergent environment; frontend falls back gracefully to SVG line icons, but the endpoint should catch missing-object errors and return 404 to stop console-spamming 500s. Audio TTS not exercised (per instructions, LLM budget concerns).

minor.issue: Returns 500 when the referenced Object Storage asset is missing. Root cause: seed docs (from source repo) have illustration_generated paths whose bytes aren't present in this env's Object Storage; requests.HTTPError bubbles up. Should be caught and return 404. File: backend/media_cache.py (cached_object) or backend/server.py::media_for_category. Frontend already handles 404 with SVG fallback.
Same root cause — returns 500 for stories whose hero_image_generated references a missing Object Storage object. Should return 404.

integration_issues.issue: Console flooded with 500s from /api/category-media/* and /api/media/*. Not user-visible (SVG fallback renders), but pollutes logs and slows the page. Fix by returning 404 on missing storage assets (see backend minor issue).

action_items: Backend: catch missing-object errors in /api/category-media and /api/media (backend/server.py or media_cache.cached_object) and return 404 so the frontend's SVG fallback triggers cleanly and console stops showing 500s.

Optional: run a one-time script to null out `illustration_generated`/`hero_image_generated` in Mongo for docs whose Object Storage bytes aren't present in this env, so the endpoints never attempt the remote fetch.
TTS audio generation was not tested per instructions; validate once separately if EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget allows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1500 lines — consider splitting routes into modules (content, user, stripe, tts, media) for maintainability, but this is source-repo code and out of scope for the migration.
media_cache.cached_object should translate upstream 404/HTTPError into HTTPException(404) instead of letting requests.HTTPError propagate (currently causes 500).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (functional flows); image media endpoints degraded (500->should be 404)

seed_data_creation: Auto-seeded by backend startup: 12 categories, 437 stories (STORIES + LESSONS_A + LESSONS_B). Test user ids prefixed TEST_migration_* are created via GET /api/user/{id} and left in Mongo (anonymous, harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Migration is complete and functional. If main agent fixes media endpoints (return 404 on missing Object Storage), retest with: curl -s -o /dev/null -w %{http_code} https://<preview>/api/category-media/scienza (expect 404) and reload the app — console should be clean. All other flows (onboarding, discover, deep-dive, bookmark, saved, stats, topics, language toggle) already verified working via Playwright.
rca_of_issue: 500 on media endpoints — the seed_data lists Object Storage paths from the original repo's bucket (pause/category/... and pause/hero/...). In this fresh Emergent env, only Mongo is migrated; the Object Storage bucket is empty. media_cache.cached_object() calls the storage service via requests; when it gets a 404 it raises HTTPError, which FastAPI turns into a 500 instead of 404. Fix: wrap the storage fetch in try/except HTTPError and re-raise HTTPException(404). Frontend already has proper fallback and remains usable.
